Oregon FIA calibration data: site climate

Source: R/data.R
fia_env_dt.Rd

Climate per site and year for the fia_obs_dt training sites (fia_env_dt) and the fia_obs_test holdout sites (fia_env_test), in natural units (not standardised – fit() z-scales internally with env_autoscale). One row per simulated year 1..22: the row of year k drives the year that ends k years after the first inventory, so every site x year in the observation tables is covered, and the years after a site's last inventory are simulated but not scored. The climate is the plot's WorldClim normal, the same in every year.

Usage

fia_env_dt

fia_env_test

Format

A data.table with 4400 rows and 8 columns: 200 sites x 22 years, one row per site x year.

siteID, year

site index and simulated year (1..22).

temp, tempmax, tempmin

annual mean, warmest-month maximum and coldest-month minimum temperature, degrees C (bioclim 1, 5, 6).

prec, precwarmq

annual and warmest-quarter precipitation, mm (bioclim 12, 18).

precseas

precipitation seasonality, coefficient of variation (bioclim 15).

An object of class data.table (inherits from data.frame) with 4400 rows and 8 columns.

Source

A seeded subsample of Oregon plots of the US Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA) database, with WorldClim bioclimatic variables attached per plot. The preparation script and the provenance of the source tables are in the package repository (dev/make_extdata.R, data-raw/README.md).

See also

Other fia datasets: fia_init_trees, fia_obs_dt, fia_species_dt, fia_tree_dt

Examples

library(data.table)
head(fia_env_dt)
#>    siteID  year     temp tempmax tempmin  prec precseas precwarmq
#>     <int> <int>    <num>   <num>   <num> <int>    <num>     <int>
#> 1:      1     1 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
#> 2:      1     2 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
#> 3:      1     3 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
#> 4:      1     4 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
#> 5:      1     5 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
#> 6:      1     6 3.958333    24.7   -10.4   547 30.04612       101
# one row per site and simulated year; the climate of a site is its normal,
# repeated for every year
fia_env_dt[, .(sites = uniqueN(siteID), first_year = min(year), last_year = max(year))]
#>    sites first_year last_year
#>    <int>      <int>     <int>
#> 1:   200          1        22
# the range of the two predictors the package examples use, over the sites
fia_env_dt[year == 1, .(temp_min = min(temp), temp_max = max(temp),
                        prec_min = min(prec), prec_max = max(prec))]
#>     temp_min temp_max prec_min prec_max
#>        <num>    <num>    <int>    <int>
#> 1: 0.4041666 12.12917      249     2786
